summary: Launch-hardening full regression PASSED. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter25_launch.py covering (a) forgot-password + reset-password + login-with-new-password + restore, (b) resend-verification auth-required + rate-limited, (c) SUPER_ADMIN users/workspaces search + suspend, (d) non-super users get 403 on all /admin/platform/* endpoints, (e) SUPER_ADMIN cannot be suspended (400), (f) suspended user gets 403 'suspended' on login and can be reinstated, (g) public leads dedupe with case-insensitive email merge (merged:true), (h) /scan/confirm duplicate detection + force override, (i) analytics overview with days=7/30/90 (range_days honored), (j) /admin/analytics/export.csv returns text/csv with 'TapPresence' branding, (k) poster + /api/config free of user-visible ARIADNI, (l) tenant isolation for a freshly registered user. Frontend: /forgot (forgot-email/forgot-submit), /reset (reset-pw/reset-pw2/reset-submit), /verify (verify-error path), /legal/terms (legal-title + 4 cross-links) all render correctly. Dashboard shows analytics range toggle (range-7/30/90) that refires GET /api/admin/analytics/overview?days=7, ranked leaderboard markers (#1, #2) present, analytics-export button present. /admin/platform user-support tab shows 5 rows for query 'ariadni' with 4 suspend buttons (self-suspend correctly omitted for the super admin row). No user-visible 'ARIADNI' text on dashboard/legal pages. robots.txt and sitemap.xml both HTTP 200. Verify banner correctly absent for already-verified super admin.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:274 suspend check runs after credential validation which is correct — no user-enumeration leak (403 only returned to authenticated correct-password users).

backend/platform_v1.py:1450 super_admin suspend guard is correct (400 Cannot suspend a platform admin). Ideally also guard the LAST remaining super_admin against DB-level deletion, but that is out of scope for this iteration.

backend/platform_v1.py forgot-password + reset-password: reset link is logged via logger.info at INFO — in production ensure log retention is <= 1h and INFO log is not shipped to third-party sinks (currently written to /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log which is fine for the preview env). session revocation on reset (line 941) is a good practice.
backend/platform_v1.py resend_verification uses rate_limit(request, 'resend_verify', 5, 3600) — good; consider a stricter per-user (not per-IP) limit for account-owned mutations.

backend/server.py create_lead dedupe (find_duplicate_lead) merges on card+email (case-insensitive) as spec'd; touches counter increments properly and message is appended to notes with date prefix — non-destructive.
backend/platform_v1.py scan_confirm dedupe returns {ok:false, duplicate:{...}} with 200 status which lets the frontend show the panel — good UX contract. force:true bypass works.
Analytics /api/admin/analytics/overview + export.csv: range_days round-trips correctly for 7/30/90; CSV Content-Disposition properly includes days in filename. No ARIADNI branding in CSV output.

Test users registered against a public /api/auth/register endpoint cannot be deleted via any exposed API — cleanup had to be done via direct Mongo. Consider adding a SUPER_ADMIN DELETE /api/admin/platform/users/{id} for full lifecycle management (only 'suspend' exists today).
